description: This file defines an Angular service class 'ApiService' that provides centralized, typed methods for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) to a backend API. It manages constructing URLs based on a base URL from environment config and handles query parameters. The service is designed for reuse across Angular components and to facilitate switching to auto-generated clients in the future.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: An Angular service providing centralized API request methods with URL handling and typed responses.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Constructs a full API URL from a given path, ensuring correct formatting.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the constructed URL with optional query parameters.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to the constructed URL with the provided request body.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request to the constructed URL with the provided request body.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PATCH request to the constructed URL with the provided request body.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the constructed URL with optional query parameters.
